pageCache.text:
Growing and learning together
Sharing the love of God
St John's
On behalf of the team here at St John’s CE Primary School I would like to welcome you to our school website, where I hope you will find a lot of useful information about our school. We are a one-form entry primary school welcoming children from the age of 2 years 3 months to age 11. St John’s is committed to providing a strong Christian ethos which is at the heart of all that we do as a school. We pride ourselves on our family feel, our inclusivity and our ambition for all children to become successful learners and caring citizens.
Useful Links
Latest News
Follow Us
Year 6 - As you leave primary school today, we want to say how proud we are of everything you have achieved. You have been a wonderful part of our school family, and we will miss your smiles, energy, and enthusiasm. Good luck as you begin your next adventure at secondary school. Believe in yourselves, work hard, be kind, and never stop aiming high. Wishing you every success and happiness for the future. From all the staff at St John's #growingandlearningtogether #stjohnswey
Year 5 had a great time yesterday, Tuesday 21st July, making ramen as part of their DT unit. They carefully thought about what items they wanted in their ramen, taste tested different noodles and designed what they would have in their bowl. The children then carefully chopped up the vegetables and cooked their broth and noodles. Ramen was enjoyed by all! #growingandlearningtogether #stjohnswey
Teddy & Book Sale We will be holding a teddy & book sale after school tomorrow, Thursday 16th July, under the Key Stage 1 shelter. Prices range from 50p - £1. All money raised will go towards the PTA.
Moana Live Musical Take a look at some photos of our amazing Moana Live Musical. Remember, you will be able to purchase a downloadable copy of the performance for £6.50 per copy. Full details will be sent by email over the next few days.
What an amazing job our children have been doing with Seedlings Education. Thank you so much to James for creating this beautiful garden #growingandlearningtogether #stjohnswey
Year 6 River Dart Update Everyone has had some sleep and a nice big breakfast ready for today's activities
Teddy Sale We will be holding a teddy sale after school tomorrow, Tuesday 14th July, under the Key Stage 1 shelter. Prices range from 50p - £1. All money raised will go towards the school library. We will also be selling a range of cans, fruit shoots and bottled water for £1 each. Lost property will also be available to look through.
We will be selling a range of cans, fruit shoots and bottled water after school today, Monday 13th July, under the KS1 Shelter £1 per drink. Please bring some small change and support our PTA by buying a drink. Lost property will also be available to look through.
Year 6 River Dart Update They have all arrived safely and the children are now setting up their rooms before spending the afternoon taking part in activities
Moana the Musical! The children have done us SO PROUD! A massive well done to everyone. Thank you so much to everyone who has helped put on this incredible show! We have had amazing help from staff, pupils, families and friends to make this wonderful show happen. A special thank you to Mrs Allen & Mrs Crouch
Reminder - We would like to invite all parents, carers and family members to our KS1 Sports Day today, Wednesday 1st July. It will take place on the KS1 field, 1.30-3pm. All children will need to wear their PE kit, sun cream and a hat. Please ensure they have a water bottle in school. We look forward to seeing you there!
Wow, what a fantastic fundraising event!! Thank you to Mrs Taylor, Mrs Crouch and everyone who helped out and supported our colour run today, Tuesday 30th June. Please remember to collect your sponsorship money (minimum of £5 per child please) and return it to your child's class by Friday 3rd July. Thank you.

pageCache.pageTitle: St John's Church of England Primary School - About
pageCache.text:
About
Welcome to St Johns Nursery, My name is Mrs Haskins and I am the Nursery Teacher.
I have worked within Early Years for nearly 20 years and have been part of St John's Primary School since 2019.
I am supported by a team of 3 staff members, Mrs Walters is the Nursery leader and Miss Nicklen and Mrs Sheldon are Nursery Practitioners. As a team we support the children in all aspects of their care and education whilst they are with us. Our aim is to provide a safe and loving environment where you child can thrive and grow under the care of well qualified practitioners.
We are very privileged to have access to all of the wider school resources so your child can expect to have a weekly session in the forest and access to all the large play parks within the school grounds. We attend the weekly singing assembly where we are welcomed by the Headteacher, Mrs Aze, and the children from reception through to year 6. Our Lunch club is enjoyed in the school hall with the Reception class and if you wish, your child can enjoy a hot lunch prepared in the school kitchen.
We offer sessions every morning from 8.45am-11.45am and every afternoon from 12.15pm-3.15pm. Session are covered by 2year funding, 3year funding and 30 hour funding, or charge at £12.75 depending on your wishes or government entitlement. If you require childcare for a full day you can add a lunch club at a small charge of £2.12 to cover the time between 11.45am-12.15pm.
Our spaces fill up very quickly and are allocated on a first come first served basis. If you feel St Johns Nursery can offer what you want for your child then please get in touch, either via email nursery@stjohnswey.dsat.org.uk or via phone 01305 785790. The team here are very happy to help and support you with your application.
We look forward to meeting you and your family.
Morning session: 8:45 - 11:45
Lunch session: 11:45 - 12:15
Afternoon session 12:15 - 3:15
For more information about our Nursery, or to book a visit, please contact the Nursery office either by email
nursery@stjohnswey.dsat.org.uk or calling us on 01305 785790.

pageCache.pageTitle: St John's Church of England Primary School - Wraparound Care
pageCache.text:
Wraparound Care
At St John’s we are able to offer a safe, engaging, and nurturing environment for your child outside of school hours.
This service is designed to give both parents and children peace of mind, knowing that your child will be in good hands while continuing to have fun and learn.
The clubs are open to children between the ages of 3-11 years old.
The clubs will not operate on INSET Days.
Breakfast Club is available from 8am. The session costs £4 per child, which includes breakfast. The club will be operating between the hours from 8-8.30am term time only.
Our aim is to provide a well-rounded experience with a variety of activities, including arts and crafts, games, outdoor play, cookery and homework support.
The club will be operating between the hours of 3.15pm-5.45pm term time only.
We have 2 sessions available;
Changes to After School Club finish time
As of Monday 1st June 2026, the finishing time will change to 5.00pm. This will ensure that numbers attending can cover staffing costs.
The session bookings available will be as follows:
Breakfast Club
Breakfast Club is open every morning during term time from 8.00-8.30am. Access is via the main school car park. When looking at the school, to the left of the blue gates, next to the bike shed, is a green fence with a gate, please use this entrance.
We are committed to the Healthy School’s Initiative and provide a wide range of healthy, nutritious options such as toasted breads, fruits, cereals and drinks.
The cost of Breakfast Club is £4.00 a session. All sessions will need to be booked and paid for via the Arbor App.
Please speak to the office and request your child to be added to the club as an eligible child and you will then be able to locate the booking system via 'Quick Actions' - 'Clubs'. Please note, spaces are limited. Your child's place will not be confirmed without payment. We are unable to accept children that have NOT been booked in via the Arbor App.
Afterschool Club
Child Care Services
Activities: The club includes various activities such as arts and crafts, outdoor play, homework support, and structured group games. Activities will vary depending on the day and age of the children.
Supervision: Children will be supervised by qualified staff at all times. The staff-to-child ratio is 1:8 ensuring proper supervision.
Food and Snacks: The club will offer light snacks and all food will comply with any known allergies/tolerances and dietary requirements.
Behaviour and Discipline: Positive behaviour is encouraged. If a child’s behaviour is disruptive or harmful to others, parents will be informed, and appropriate actions will be taken, which may include a meeting with the parents or a temporary suspension from the club.
Location: Access is via the main school car park. When looking at the school, to the left of the blue gates, next to the bike shed, is a green fence with a gate, please use this entrance.
Authorised Pickups: Children will be released to a parent/carer or an emergency contact listed on the child’s Arbor profile and who are over the age of 16. Please inform the club leader if the person collecting is not a parent/carer.
Late Pickup: If a child is not picked up by the end of your booked session, a late fee of £10 will be charged.
Booking and Payments
Process: Bookings must be made and paid for, a minimum of 4 hours in advance of the session, via our parent portal – The Arbor App. Your child’s place in the club will not be secured without full payment in advance. Please go to ‘Quick Actions’, click on ‘Clubs’ and select ‘After School Club’. You will be given the choice of 2 sessions per day, Early and Full, you must ensure that you select the correct session to meet your needs.
A late fee will be applied to your account, via the Arbor App, for all children who are collected after their booked session. This will be charged at £10 per child.
Payment Method: Payments can be made by debit card or Childcare Vouchers.
Cancellation by the Parent: Parents may cancel a booking with written notice 48 hours in advance.
Cancellation by the Club: The club reserves the right to terminate care immediately in cases of non-payment, severe behavioural issues, or violation of the terms and conditions.

SEND
Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND)
At St. John's Primary School we are committed to the equal inclusion of all pupils in all areas of primary school life. Every child is entitled to a broad and balanced education. We have an inclusive culture in our school and we are responsive to the diversity of children’s backgrounds, interests, experience, knowledge and skills. We recognise the diverse and individual needs of all of our pupils and take into account the additional support required by those children with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND).
The school SENCO is Miss Kirsty Jones.
(Usual working days are Wednesday and Friday.)
Email: Sendco@stjohnswey.dsat.org.uk
Telephone: 01305 785711
Our Family Liaison Officer, Mrs Martin, is also available to support our families and children.
If any parent/carer has a question regarding the SEND process, the first port of call is the class teacher. If you need to speak to your child’s class teacher, please email them via office@stjohnswey.dsat.org.uk
If the class teacher feels the best approach is for parents to meet with Miss Jones, they will always advise this.
Dorset's Local Offer provides county wide information and guidance for children and young people with special educational needs and disabilities.
